text:
The plate looks like a side plate of about 22 cm. It holds 3-4 strips of dark, glazed bacon, which may be candied, plus a small portion of broccoli.

The bacon strips are long, about 15 cm each. Cooked bacon weighs roughly 8 g per strip, or about 10 g if glazed. Four strips come to about 35 g, which is roughly 190 kcal at about 5 kcal/g for a candied version.

The broccoli is about 60 g at 35 kcal/100 g, so about 20 kcal. There may also be a little oil on it, which adds around 20 kcal.

Total: about 95 g and about 230 kcal.
